skills.name: app-compare
skills.description: Use for side-by-side comparisons of apps or frontends ("A vs B vs C") or a one-page app snapshot across Hyperliquid builder data, Polymarket builder data and DefiLlama fees.

skills.name: app-registry
skills.description: Use to look up, add or verify which Hyperliquid builder addresses, Polymarket builder codes or DefiLlama slugs belong to an app, wallet or trading frontend.

skills.name: hyperliquid-builders
skills.description: Use for Hyperliquid builder codes and the frontends behind them (wallets, trading apps, terminals) — builder revenue, volume, unique traders, take rate, retention, whale concentration, rankings or comparisons.

skills.name: hyperliquid-trader
skills.description: Use when asked about a specific Hyperliquid address — open positions, account value, recent fills, realized PnL net of fees, fee tier, or which frontends (builder codes) it trades through.

skills.name: onchain-methodology
skills.description: Use before reporting any on-chain metric (revenue, volume, traders, retention, PnL, fees), or when asked how a number was computed or whether it can be trusted.

skills.name: onchain-report
skills.description: Use when the user wants an on-chain analysis delivered as a CSV, a chart, or a short Markdown memo rather than a chat answer.

skills.name: onchain-setup-toolkit
skills.description: Use when the optional onchain toolkit is missing, outdated or failing, or the user wants faster, cached analysis; skills still work without it.

skills.name: onchain-source-map
skills.description: Use before answering any on-chain, Hyperliquid, Polymarket or protocol-fee question, to pick the right free public source and respect its limits.

skills.name: onchain-update-skills
skills.description: Use when the user asks to update, check or repair the Onchain Analyst skills or toolkit, or mentions a newer release; also use when a short starter skill should be upgraded to its full version.

skills.name: polymarket-builders
skills.description: Use for Polymarket builder codes (apps that route orders to Polymarket) — rankings by volume, active makers, builder-fee revenue, notional and take rate over a day, week or month.

skills.name: polymarket-markets
skills.description: Use for finding Polymarket markets or events and their prices, price history, order book, liquidity, open interest, top holders or recent trades.

skills.name: polymarket-wallets
skills.description: Use when asked about a Polymarket wallet or trader — open and closed positions, realized/unrealized PnL, PnL over time, biggest wins, volume, or recent activity.

skills.name: product-revenue-map
skills.description: Use when asked how much any on-chain app, wallet, frontend or protocol makes (revenue, fees, volume, users) across all its products and chains. Maps the business model to on-chain footprints, measures each line once, rolls up with dedupe rules and cross-checks aggregators.

skills.name: protocol-fees
skills.description: Use for a protocol's or app's fees, revenue or holders revenue over time, fee rankings across protocols, or current token prices.

skills.name: onchain-getting-started
skills.description: Use on the first conversation after this bot is added, or when Onchain Analyst skills are missing, outdated or short starter versions.
